description: Use this when the user asks how their Facebook or Instagram ads performed. Pull performance INSIGHTS for a connected Meta ad account, or a specific campaign / ad set / ad: spend, impressions, reach, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, frequency, and the conversions and video numbers Meta reports. Pass adAccountId (for auth); optionally objectId to scope to one object and level (campaign / adset / ad) for one named row per campaign, ad set or ad. EVERY ROW CARRIES `kpis`, the Ads Manager columns read out of Meta's arrays: purchases with purchaseValue, costPerPurchase (CPA) and purchaseRoas (purchase ROAS); addToCart (adds to cart), initiateCheckout (checkouts started), landingPageViews (landing page views) and costPerLandingPageView; linkClicks with linkCtr (link CTR) and linkCpc (link CPC); video3sPlays (3-second video plays), thruPlays (ThruPlay), videoP25 / P50 / P75 / P95 / P100 (plays to 25%, 50%, 75%, 95%, 100%) and videoAvgWatchSeconds (average watch time). A kpi that is null was not reported by Meta for that row: say "not reported", never zero. timeIncrement gives one row per day (1 or "daily"), per week (7) or "monthly" in ONE call. attributionSetting:"adset" counts conversions with each ad set's own attribution setting, as Ads Manager's columns do; attributionWindows (e.g. "7d_click,1d_view") adds each window's count beside the total. fields adds more of Meta's insights fields (e.g. "attribution_setting,quality_ranking,outbound_clicks"); an unknown name is refused, never dropped. Up to 500 rows a call: pass limit, and after:nextCursor for the next page. BREAKDOWNS are what make the numbers actionable — a flat total says an ad cost $X, never WHO it worked on: pass breakdowns:"age,gender", "publisher_platform,platform_position" (which placement), "country" / "region" / "comscore_market" (where — US metro; Meta retired "dma" for it, and "dma" is sent as comscore_market), "impression_device" / "device_platform" (what they held). Comma-separated; "placement", "device" and "geo" are accepted as aliases; an unknown value is REJECTED, never silently ignored. THREE breakdowns need an ad-account OPT-IN from 2026-08-06 — impression_device, hourly_stats_aggregated_by_audience_time_zone and frequency_value: Meta returns NO ROWS (not an error) for an account that has not opted in, so they are always ATTEMPTED, and if nothing comes back the report is re-run WITHOUT them and `droppedBreakdowns` + a note name the missing dimension and say an account admin can enable it in Ads Manager. A dropped dimension is ABSENT, never zero — never present the remaining total as if it were still split by it. Date window: datePreset OR since+until (YYYY-MM-DD). datePreset is Meta's OWN enum — today, yesterday, last_3d, last_7d, last_14d, last_28d, last_30d, last_90d, this_week_mon_today, this_week_sun_today, last_week_mon_sun, last_week_sun_sat, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year, maximum, data_maximum. THERE IS NO "lifetime": Meta disabled it in Graph API v10.0 and replaced it with "maximum" (the last 37 months); anything unrecognised is refused by name here rather than 400ing at Meta. Read-only.

actionBreakdowns.description: comma-separated, e.g. "action_type,action_device" — splits the conversion/action counts

actionReportTime.description: which day a conversion is counted on: the day of the ad impression, or the day the conversion happened

after.description: the nextCursor of the previous page

attributionSetting.description: how conversions are attributed: "adset" = each ad set's own setting (what Ads Manager's columns show), "account" = the ad account's setting, "default" or omitted = Meta's default (7-day click and 1-day view)

attributionWindows.description: comma-separated windows to report beside each action total: 1d_click, 7d_click, 28d_click, 1d_view, 7d_view, 28d_view, 1d_ev, dda, default

datePreset.description: Meta's date_preset enum, default last_30d: today | yesterday | last_3d | last_7d | last_14d | last_28d | last_30d | last_90d | this_week_mon_today | this_week_sun_today | last_week_mon_sun | last_week_sun_sat | this_month | last_month | this_quarter | last_quarter | this_year | last_year | maximum | data_maximum. NOT "lifetime" — Meta retired it in v10.0; use "maximum" (37 months) or since+until.

fields.description: comma-separated extra Meta insights fields to add to every row, e.g. "attribution_setting,quality_ranking,outbound_clicks,website_purchase_roas,objective"

level.description: break the numbers down by this level

objectId.description: a campaign / ad set / ad id to scope to (default: the whole account)

since.description: start date YYYY-MM-DD (use with until). Meta keeps 37 months: an older start is moved to the oldest day Meta has, and the note says so

timeIncrement.description: one row per period instead of one for the whole window: 1 or "daily" = per day, 7 or "weekly" = per week, any whole number of days 1–90, or "monthly". Default: one row for the whole window

name: meta_insights
title: Meta ad performance metrics
